platform: Revealed Recordings Account-Gated Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Revealed Recordings exposes Upload Demo in its official navigation, but opening the route redirects to an email/password login page with account creation and an optional Spotify connection. A human must review account terms, any demo-credit or Pro boundary, public/private visibility, ownership, master status, metadata, permitted audio delivery and all live declarations before upload.

platform: Protocol Recordings Exclusive LabelRadar Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: Protocol Recordings accepts unsigned productions only through its embedded widget or official LabelRadar link. It excludes bootlegs, mash-ups and promos, requires the demo to be offered exclusively to Protocol, asks artists not to submit twice and states that interest will be communicated within 30 days. A human must approve the exclusivity window, LabelRadar account or session, rights, master, metadata, link or upload settings and all live platform terms.

platform: Armada Music Official Dynamic Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: Armada Music exposes a dedicated Demo drop destination in the official site navigation. The public static view does not reveal the complete rendered field set, file or private-link requirements, label selection, rights declarations, login state, CAPTCHA state or any runtime pricing boundary. A human must open the live workflow and approve every field, term, ownership statement, master and metadata requirement before submission.

platform: Ninja Tune Direct Digital Demo Email Route
manual_review_reason: Ninja Tune's official demo policy accepts digital demos at demos@ninjatune.net using links to MP3 files, SoundCloud pages or websites, explicitly forbids MP3 email attachments, asks for contact details in the email body, requests a short submission with the best tracks first and says not to chase for a response. A human must select appropriate tracks, verify rights and link permissions, prepare concise metadata and ensure no prohibited attachment is included.

platform: Anjunabeats General Contact Pre-Submission Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: Anjunabeats publishes an official contact form, but its visible topic list does not include demos or unsolicited music. This record is therefore limited to a short asset-free General-topic inquiry asking whether the label currently accepts external demos and which authorized route applies. A human must inspect the live form, avoid attaching or linking music, respect any runtime verification and stop if the form or response says unsolicited submissions are not accepted.
